after.zh: 离焦就是模糊，模糊压低了高频。所以频谱外圈越亮，照片越清楚。手机相机对焦时，一边挪镜头一边算这样的分数，停在分数最高的位置。
after.en: Out of focus means blurred, and blurring turns the high frequencies down. So the brighter the outer part of the spectrum, the sharper the photo. A phone camera computes a score like this while it moves the lens, and stops where the score is highest.

t.zh: <level-ref to="2-5"></level-ref>的探针量一行里的一个频率。图像是二维的，波可以横着、竖着、斜着走。对每一种方向和疏密都做一次探针，读数排成一张图，就是<part-ref to="spectrum"></part-ref>：正中心是平均亮度，越往外的格子代表变化越快的波。
t.en: <level-ref to="2-5"></level-ref>'s probe measured one frequency in a row. Images are 2-D, so waves run across, down or at a slant. Run the probe for every direction and density and lay the readings out as a picture, and you have the <part-ref to="spectrum"></part-ref>: the centre is the average brightness, and cells further out stand for faster-changing waves.

caption.zh: 第一组测试照片的频谱
caption.en: The spectrum of the first test photo

t.zh: 相机自动对焦时，要一边挪镜头一边判断：现在这张清楚吗？
t.en: When a camera focuses itself, it moves the lens and keeps asking: is this shot sharp now?

t.zh: 新画法<part-ref to="spectrum"></part-ref>：画出每个频率的波有多强，中心是频率 (0, 0)，越往外频率越高。
t.en: A new way of drawing, <part-ref to="spectrum"></part-ref>: how strong the wave at each frequency is, with frequency (0, 0) at the centre and higher frequencies further out.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：按说明里的规则，给每张照片算一个清晰度分。「频率半径」是一张和频谱一样大的图，每格写着它离中心多远。要想的问题：糊掉的照片，频谱哪里变暗了？
t.en: Your task in this level: score each photo for sharpness by the rule in the brief. "Frequency radius" is a picture the size of the spectrum, each cell holding its distance from the centre. Something to think about: where does the spectrum of a blurred photo get darker?

brief.zh: 相机自动对焦时，要给每一张试拍打一个清晰度分。输出这个分：照片的频谱里，离中心超过 6 的那些格子加起来，再除以频谱的格子总数。「频率半径」告诉你频谱每一格离中心多远。
brief.en: When a camera focuses itself, it scores every trial shot for sharpness. Output that score: the sum of the spectrum cells more than 6 from the centre, divided by the total number of spectrum cells. "Frequency radius" tells you how far each spectrum cell is from the centre.

hint.zh: 先做一张只在半径 6 以外为 1 的图，用它把频谱的内圈遮住。
hint.en: First make a picture that is 1 only beyond radius 6, and use it to mask out the inner part of the spectrum.
